correctness.rationale: For every a,b at least two over any finite characteristic-two field, determinant lemma gives the exact characteristic polynomial, direct first/second power kernel calculations at eigenvalues zero and one force each nilpotent/unipotent Jordan chain, and the remaining order-three polynomial determines the final cyclic component. Möbius period counting and Fitting coordinate enumeration yield exact orbit and transient tables. The embedded directly computed standard-library checker passed 169 matrix parameter pairs, 11280 binary states and 47360 four-element-field states; finite tests only corroborate the infinite proof.

The inspected general Boolean-states paper studies maxterm/minterm and OR/AND/NOR/NAND families, not mixed XOR. The full XOR-digraph source remains an acknowledged unresolved comparison.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The exact operator is F=diag(I_a,0_b)+11^T on all-to-all networks. An equivalent formulation would classify mixed-loop complete directed graphs or rank-one diagonal two-level maps, including their rational blocks, primitive periods and transient shells. The full-text homogeneous result changes every diagonal entry together and yields only periods 1,2,4, whereas the odd/odd mixed operator has a genuine order-three cyclic summand. The inaccessible directed-graph source cannot be declared absent from full-text overlap.

originality.rationale: A complete statement-and-implication comparison against the nearest accessible published parity census, two full-text 2015 primary works and related linear finite dynamical systems literature did not identify coverage of a mixed self-inclusion complete graph. The homogeneous complete-multipartite theorem covers only globally uniform choice of diagonal and has no primitive period three; the present theorem exhibits period three for both feedback group sizes odd. A directly relevant XOR directed-graph paper could not be read in full and remains a stated residual equivalence risk; no inference of global priority from failed searches is made.
residual_risks: Full text of Kozerenko and Valverde (2019/2020) was not accessible, so unknown treatment of arbitrary partial loops is the main historical-equivalence risk.
Unindexed or unpublished earlier results concerning two-diagonal rank-one finite-field updates may exist.
The full 2005 classical linear systems article was not inspected; only abstract and bibliographic claims were checked.

value.rationale: The parameter is a canonical structural notion—the parity of the two vertex groups that respectively omit and include their own state in a complete interaction network. One obtains a complete four-phase law simultaneously for exact rational/Jordan blocks, all primitive orbit populations and stopping-time shells. In particular, a genuine 3-periodic orbit occurs for mixed odd/odd groups although both homogeneous endpoints have eventual periods dividing two. The exact invariant is natural and provides an interpretable emergent effect of feedback heterogeneity, not a selected small computation.
